answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 32923 Country: India Title: (1) If the husband and wife are offering "Salah" in the same room at the same time, is it admissible if the wife stands at two steps backward at Hayya Alal Falah on the side of husband? Question: (1) If the husband and wife are offering "Salah" in the same room at the same time, is it admissible if the wife stands at two steps backward at Hayya Alal Falah on the side of husband? (2) Whether doing masah on back side of neck is bida'h while performing ablution (wudhu). (3) Whether it is permissible to get child by surrogate mother for childless couples. If yes, under what circumstances? Answer ID: 32923 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1026/859/B=1432) (1) Yes, both the husband and wife can offer salah in the same room in the same time but both of them should not stand side by side rather they should stand with some gap. There should be the gap of more than two steps. (2) No, it is not bida'h rather it is mustahab. (3) It is not lawful. It is haram. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
